title: US poultry affected by H5N1 avian flu, cumulative since Feb 2022 (million birds)

source.name: Confirmed HPAI detections in commercial and backyard flocks
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS)

notes: Cumulative U.S. poultry affected since the outbreak began Feb 2022, sampled at year-end (2022 ~58M full-year total per APHIS/CIDRAP; 2023 adds ~22M for a ~80M running total; 2024 running total ~148M per widely reported APHIS-sourced figure; 2025 running total ~179M per APHIS FY25 Q4 epidemiologic report (as of Sept 30, 2025); 2026 running total ~206M per May 2026 reporting). Snapshot dates vary through each year; figures rounded to the nearest million.
